tickets.title: Repo skeleton, test harness, lint, light CI green on empty suite
tickets.objective: Bootstrap so every downstream verify command is runnable: Python backend (uv, pytest, ruff), Vite React frontend (vitest), scripts dir, light GHA workflow, .env.example.
acceptance: backend/ initialized with uv; pytest and ruff configured; empty suite passes
frontend/ Vite React TS scaffold builds; vitest configured with one trivial passing test
.github/workflows/ci.yml: single job, ruff + pytest, pull_request trigger only
.env.example lists every env var named in DESIGN.md; no secrets committed
tickets.verify: cd backend && uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check src && cd ../frontend && npm run -s build
non_goals: No app logic; no provider SDK calls; no Docker/Fly config

tickets.title: Voice loop works end-to-end: STT -> LLM -> TTS on LiveKit with state events
tickets.objective: LiveKit Agents worker joins a room, streams Deepgram STT in, a single fast model replies, Cartesia TTS streams out; FastAPI token endpoint; agent_state and transcript data-channel events per DESIGN.
acceptance: Worker registers with LiveKit and completes a synthetic audio turn in tests with mocked STT/TTS providers
POST /api/token returns a valid LiveKit token per the pinned request/response shape
agent_state transitions listening->thinking->speaking emitted on the data channel
TTS provider selected by env var; Cartesia default, Aura-2 fallback both wired
Per-turn latency JSONL logging in place (turn_end_ts, first_audio_ts)
tickets.verify: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/pipeline -q && uv run ruff check src
non_goals: No tools, no memory, no grounding policy, no frontend

tickets.title: Grounded tool-calling core: routing, ANSWER_POLICY, refusal, self-manifest
tickets.objective: Dual-model routing (CONVO_MODEL always-on, TOOL_MODEL escalation for heavy tools), ToolResult type, tool registry, synthesize_grounded with REFUSAL behavior, capabilities.yaml + self_manifest tool (R5).
acceptance: ToolResult, REFUSAL, synthesize_grounded implemented exactly as pinned in DESIGN.md
Routing escalates to TOOL_MODEL only for tools tagged heavy
Given empty/irrelevant tool results, answer starts with REFUSAL (unit-tested on fixture transcripts)
Capability questions answered solely from capabilities.yaml (unit-tested)
tickets.verify: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/grounding -q && uv run ruff check src
non_goals: No concrete external tools (weather/github land in T-3/T-4)

tickets.title: Weather answers grounded in live Open-Meteo data
tickets.objective: get_weather tool (geocode + forecast, keyless Open-Meteo) returning ToolResult; answers cite recency when asked (R8).
acceptance: get_weather returns pinned ToolResult shape for now/today/week using recorded API fixtures
Unknown location or API error yields ToolResult.error and a REFUSAL-path answer, not a guess
fetched_at populated; recency question answered from it (unit-tested)
tickets.verify: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/tools/test_weather.py -q
non_goals: No paid weather providers; no caching layer

tickets.title: GitHub Q&A grounded in live repo data with graceful oversize degradation
tickets.objective: load_repo_digest (gitingest, cached by (repo, head_sha), 15-min TTL, token budget) and github_query (githubkit GraphQL: open_prs, open_issues, pr_comments, last_merges, repo_meta), both heavy-tagged (R7).
acceptance: Both tools return pinned ToolResult shapes against recorded fixtures for a pinned public repo snapshot
Digest exceeding token_budget triggers targeted-query degradation, never truncated-content answering (unit-tested)
Cache hit on unchanged head_sha within TTL (unit-tested)
Invalid/private/nonexistent URL yields ToolResult.error -> REFUSAL path
tickets.verify: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/tools/test_github.py -q
non_goals: No embedding index; no write actions on repos (PR-opening is T-11)

tickets.title: Cross-session memory round-trips through self-hosted mem0 on pgvector
tickets.objective: MemoryStore protocol implemented on mem0 OSS + Postgres/pgvector (docker-compose for local dev); session turns persisted; search surfaces prior-session facts as ToolResults; preferences table created (R3).
acceptance: Round-trip test: fact stored under user U in session A is returned by search(U, ...) in a new session B
search results are ToolResult source=memory:mem0 feeding synthesize_grounded
Isolation primitive proven: search(U2) never returns U1 rows (full multi-user lands in T-10)
preferences table migrated; get/add_preference round-trip
tickets.verify: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/memory -q
non_goals: No Clerk/auth; no preference voice-capture UX (T-10)

tickets.title: Cadence and interruption feel natural: fillers, barge-in, stop phrase
tickets.objective: Filler bank pre-synthesized; >500ms heavy-tool turns get a spoken acknowledgment within 300ms; any user speech pauses playback; stop phrases cancel the turn (R2, R4). Exploratory tuning: hit the boundaries, don't gold-plate.
acceptance: Filler gating unit-tested: stubbed tool latency >500ms triggers filler, <500ms does not
Filler assets generated by scripts/build_fillers.py into assets/fillers/
Stop-phrase detection cancels turn; barge-in pauses playback (state-machine unit tests)
No-immediate-repeat filler selection unit-tested
tickets.verify: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/cadence -q
non_goals: No semantic turn-detection model swaps; LiveKit defaults + tuning only

tickets.title: Grounding eval harness passes with zero fabrications on approved golden set
tickets.objective: evals/golden.jsonl (>=30 cases: grounded answers, forced refusals, memory recalls) + evals.run executing cases against synthesize_grounded with fixture tools; Hank approves the golden set (R6a external ground truth).
acceptance: golden.jsonl has >=30 cases in the pinned schema covering all three case types
Hank has reviewed and approved golden.jsonl (approval noted in the file header comment) - REQUIRED before close
evals.run reports 0 fabrications and 0 wrong-refusals; nonzero exits nonzero
tickets.verify: cd backend && uv run python -m evals.run --golden evals/golden.jsonl --max-fabrications 0
non_goals: No live-API eval cases (fixtures only); no CI wiring (local merge gate by design)

tickets.title: Polished SPA: join, converse, see live transcript and agent state
tickets.objective: React/Vite client: token fetch, room join, mic controls, live transcript, listening/thinking/working/speaking indicators. Polished per frontend-design guidance; UI simple, UX sharp.
acceptance: Client fetches /api/token with pinned shape and joins the room (mocked in tests)
agent_state and transcript events render (component tests)
Production build passes; no Next.js anywhere in the dependency tree
tickets.verify: cd frontend && npm run -s build && npm run -s test -- --run
non_goals: No auth UI (T-10), no wake word (T-12)

tickets.title: Deployed on Fly.io: web + worker live, smoke passing, MVP demo-able
tickets.objective: Single Fly app, two process groups (web=FastAPI+static SPA, worker=agent); Fly Postgres attached; secrets set; smoke script green against the deployed URL; latency report from deployed instance meets R1.
acceptance: fly.toml defines web + worker process groups; backend Dockerfile builds
scripts/smoke_deploy.sh: health endpoint 200, token endpoint returns valid shape, worker registered
scripts/latency_report.py over >=50 deployed turns shows p95 <= 800ms (R1) - report committed as docs/latency-report.md
non_goals: No autoscaling config; no custom domains; no Vercel

tickets.title: Bonus: multi-user with Clerk - isolated memory, honored preferences, 10 concurrent
tickets.objective: Clerk sign-in in SPA; /api/token requires Clerk JWT and derives identity server-side; mem0 namespacing by Clerk user id; voice-captured standing preferences honored across sessions; 10-session load smoke (R9).
acceptance: Unauthenticated /api/token returns 401; identity comes from verified JWT (client identity ignored)
Isolation test: user A's stored fact absent from user B's recall
Preference stated by voice in session 1 is honored in session 2 (test via prefs injection path)
scripts/load_smoke.sh sustains 10 concurrent sessions without errors
tickets.verify: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/multiuser -q && bash scripts/load_smoke.sh 10
non_goals: No roles/orgs; no billing; no LiveKit self-hosting even if Cloud free-tier concurrency caps bite - flag to human instead

tickets.title: Bonus: 'fix issue #N' opens a real PR with audible progress
tickets.objective: run_fix_job: background Claude Agent SDK run in isolated workdir with scoped GITHUB_TOKEN against a user-controlled test repo; announces start/progress/PR-opened via data channel + TTS; opens PR, never merges (R10).
acceptance: Job orchestration unit-tested with a mocked agent (states: started -> progress -> pr_opened|failed)
Announcements emitted at each state transition
One recorded live run against the designated test repo produced an open PR (PR URL committed to docs/agent-pr-demo.md)
No merge or force-push capability in the token scope
tickets.verify: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/agent_pr -q
non_goals: No arbitrary-repo writes; no auto-merge; no retry queues

tickets.title: Bonus: passive mode wakes on 'Jarvis' with zero upstream audio while passive
tickets.objective: Porcupine Web SDK with built-in 'Jarvis' keyword; passive/active client state machine; mic audio published to LiveKit only in active state (R11).
acceptance: State machine unit tests: passive -> wake event -> active -> session end -> passive
Track-publish gating tested: no LiveKit audio track published while passive
Passive mode is an explicit user toggle, default off
non_goals: No custom wake words; no mobile; no background-tab guarantees
